newsitem.title: UK: Euro VGO easier as U.S. interest fades, crude dips.
newsitem.headline: Euro VGO easier as U.S. interest fades, crude dips.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices were weaker on Friday on the back of less intense U.S. interest and easier crude.
A low sulphur 45,000-tonne cargo offered yesterday at $158 fob NWE out of Scandanavia would be prepared to go for several
dollars less today, traders said. Only one buyer was seen, understood to be interested around the $150 level.
"The U.S. market is not robust enough to pick up European cargoes. The interest has become more cautious," said one trader.

A high sulphur barge was sold on Friday at $153.50 fob ARA. The parcel was destined for Germany and that country could lead a modest revival in buying interest next week as dealers start picking cargoes for October requirements.
